notes: Contract shared by tools/texgen/plaza_features.py (painter) and tools/blender/plaza_features.py (modeler).

rect = [x, y, w, h] in pixels from the image's TOP-LEFT (Blender v = 1 - y / h). Strips marked tiles 'u' are periodic along x and span the full width; the modeler may repeat them several times around a ring, always breaking at a vertex.
The game samples every street texture with NearestFilter and the three.js default ClampToEdge wrap: no texture repeats beyond 0..1, so all UVs stay inside 0..1 and repeats are done per face.

The game lights the street with one flat ambient light (no directional light, no vertex colour, no emissive): every face shows its albedo almost flat (about x0.82, x0.75, x0.55 per channel, warm). Form must be painted in: baked occlusion, bright rims, darker water under tiers. Fire reads by colour alone.

RGBA textures are flagged transparent in the IDE: alphaTest 0.5, double-sided. Alpha is painted as a hard cut-out (0 or 255 after a threshold), colour bled under the cut so the edge pixels never fringe dark.
palette_hint: Street textures in public/textures/map/: park.png (olive-buff grass, mean 96,91,63), stone.png / stone_poor.png (grey 121,120,114 and soot 61,57,54), pothole.png (32 px black cut-out), trash.png (confetti of litter). Mid values, photo-ish, every pixel shows.

env_trashcan_burning.look: Atlas for the poor-tier burning oil drum (opaque).

drum_side.look: Wraps once around an 8-sided 55-gallon drum, image top = drum top (z 4.4), bottom = ground. Old dark olive-green paint (70,78,58) surviving in ragged islands on rust (120,62,30 to 150,85,40), two raised rolling hoops as 2 px light-over-dark ridges at y 10-11 and y 21-22. Top 9 px heat-scorched: paint burnt off to blackened steel (35,30,28) fading down into bluish-brown heat tint, blistered. Rust streaks run down from the hoops; one dent shadow (soft dark oval, 8 x 6 px) near x 40, y 14. Bottom 3 px grimy dark contact. Periodic in x.

lip.look: Rolled top lip seen from above: scorched grey-black steel (60,55,52) with brighter worn metal flecks (110,100,90), a soot-black inner edge row (y 35). Periodic in x.

inner_wall.look: Inside of the drum from the lip (y 36) down to the coals (y 47): soot black (20,17,15) at the top turning into a hot glow at the bottom: orange (230,110,25) and yellow (255,190,60) ember light over the last 4 px, flickering patches. Periodic in x.

coals.look: Bed of burning trash seen from above, mapped planar onto the octagonal disc inside the drum: black charred chunks (25,20,18) with bright orange (240,120,30) and yellow-white (255,220,120) glowing gaps; brightest in the middle. Fill the whole square (the disc corners are cut by the octagon).

trash.look: Garbage bags and spill for the two lumps at the drum's foot, box-mapped: left half black-green plastic bags (30,36,30) with soft grey highlights on the folds and knotted tops, right half split into torn brown cardboard (120,92,60), crumpled grey newspaper (150,148,140) and a few colour flecks like trash.png. Soft occlusion at the bottom 2 px of the rect (ground contact).

env_trashcan_burning_fire.look: Cut-out cards: flames, smoke, ground litter. Alpha hard 0/255. Colour under transparent pixels = nearest opaque colour (bleed).

litter.look: Ground card beside the drum: scattered litter and ash, lying flat. Torn paper (170,165,150), cardboard (125,95,60), a crushed can (silver-grey), black bag scraps, grey ash smear (90,85,80) concentrated toward the left end (x 0-12, where the drum stands); alpha is a ragged scatter of pieces, about 45 % covered, nothing within 1 px of the rect border.

flame_a.look: Main flame card, base at the bottom of the rect (hidden inside the drum below 1.2 m of the card). Bottom 10 px fully opaque across the width; above, three or four licking tongues of different heights narrowing upward, the tallest reaching y 18 (2 px under the rect top), ragged fractal edges, a detached flicker or two. Colour by height and distance from the tongue axis: pale yellow-white core (255,245,175) low in the middle, yellow (255,205,55), orange (245,130,25) toward the edges and higher up, red-orange tips (205,70,20). No dark outline: the edge pixels are orange, not black. Brightness is the whole effect: no emissive in the game.

flame_b.look: Second flame card with a different tongue layout (two big tongues leaning apart, tallest reaching y 24), same colour rules as flame_a.

smoke.look: Soot plume card, base at the rect bottom (just above the flames), widening upward as stacked billowing puffs: dark sooty grey-brown (55,50,46) at the base, lighter warm grey (105,100,95) higher up; each puff has a lighter upper rim and darker underside (baked, no light direction). Alpha: solid at the bottom, breaking up into holes and separate puffs toward the top, last puff ending 2 px under the rect top; bottom 3 px transparent at the corners (rounded base).

env_fountain_normal.look: Atlas for the normal-tier fountain: drab precast concrete basin, flat blue-grey water, one column with a weak jet. Eastern-bloc functional.

wall_out.look: Outer basin wall, repeated 4 x around a 16-gon (one repeat per 4 segments), image top = rim (z 1.2), bottom = ground. Precast concrete (128,125,117) with fine aggregate speckle, a precast joint (1 px dark line + 1 px light) at x 0 and x 32, chipped top edge (lighter fresh breaks), dark water-stain streaks running down from the top, a damp darker band and moss-green tint (80,88,62) in the bottom 2 px. Periodic in x.

rim_top.look: Flat top of the rim: worn lighter concrete (145,142,134), y 10 is the outer edge, y 15 the inner (water) edge; 1 px darker arris lines at both edges, a couple of cracks crossing it, a few dark specks. Periodic in x.

wall_in.look: Inner wall from the rim (y 16) down to the water (y 21): damp dark concrete (85,86,82), shadowed (baked occlusion under the rim lip at the top row), a pale limescale line at y 19 and green-brown algae (60,70,50) in the last 2 px at the waterline. Periodic in x.

water.look: Water disc seen from above, mapped planar (rect centre = basin centre, inscribed circle radius 21 px = 4.5 m, the octagon of the inner wall touches it). Flat blue-grey (78,96,108) with soft lighter sky-sheen patches (110,128,138), darker toward the rim (baked shadow of the wall, last 4 px of the radius darker by about 30 %), two or three faint concentric ripple rings around the centre where the jet falls back (radius 4-9 px), a ring of darker wet shadow right around the column (radius 3 px), a few floating leaves and litter specks (brown, 1 px) drifted against the far rim.

column.look: Column sides wrapped once around an 8-sided shaft, image top = under the cap (z 3.0), bottom = waterline (z 0.8). Concrete as wall_out but cleaner (135,132,124), vertical water-stain streaks from the top, wet darker bottom 7 px with an algae line at the very bottom. Periodic in x over its 22 px.

cap.look: Flared cap at the top of the column: rows 54-58 the flare side (concrete, its top row catching a lighter edge, darker at the bottom where it meets the shaft), rows 59-63 the cap top seen from above as a strip from the rim (y 59) to the centre (y 63): wet dark concrete, a rusty metal nozzle ring in the last row. Periodic in x.

env_fountain_rich.look: Atlas for the rich-tier Big Fountain: dictator kitsch. Pink and white marble, polished gold, red porphyry, gilded leader on top. Paint gold as yellow with bright pale-yellow highlight rows and dark brown under-shadows (no metalness in the game).

wall.look: Outer basin wall, repeated 4 x around a 16-gon (one repeat per 4 segments, 32 px per segment), image top = rim (z 2.0), bottom = top of the base step (z 0.4). Rows 0-3: gold egg-and-dart molding (gold 225,180,60 with a 1 px pale highlight row 250,232,140 and a dark row under it 110,75,25). Rows 4-17: pink marble (220,170,165) with soft white veins; per segment (every 32 px) one recessed panel 22 x 10 px framed by a 1 px gold line, the panel field a deeper rose marble (190,120,120) with baked shadow along its top edge; Rows 18-19: darker rose plinth line. Periodic in x.

rim_top.look: Flat rim top seen from above, y 20 = outer edge, y 25 = water edge: polished gold band (rows 20-22) with one bright highlight row, then white marble coping (235,228,220) with grey-pink veins (rows 23-25), the last row a thin dark line (water edge shadow). Periodic in x.

inner_wall.look: Inner wall from the rim (y 26) down to the water (y 31): rose marble in shadow (150,105,105), darker at the top row (under the coping), a pale mineral line at y 29, turquoise-tinted wet last row. Periodic in x.

step.look: Riser of the white marble base step around the basin, y 32 = top arris (1 px bright), white marble (225,220,212) with faint grey veins, joints every 32 px, bottom 2 px darker ground grime. Periodic in x.

step_top.look: Tread of the base step seen from above, y 40 = outer edge, y 45 = against the basin wall (darker, occluded): white marble paving (230,225,215) with joints every 32 px. Periodic in x.

bowl_under.look: Underside of the tier bowls (a cone from the stem out to the lip), y 46 = outer edge under the lip, y 61 = against the stem. Pink marble gadroons: 8 vertical lobes per 128 px (16 px pitch), each lobe lighter in its middle and darker at its edges, a 1 px gold rib between lobes; the top 2 rows a gold bead; shadowed darker toward the stem (bottom 5 rows). Periodic in x.

lip.look: Gold lip band of the tier bowls and the trim bands of the stems: polished gold (225,180,60) with a pale highlight row at y 63, a dark brown row at y 67, small repeating beads (4 px pitch) in the middle rows. Periodic in x.

water.look: Basin water seen from above, planar, rect centre = basin centre, inscribed circle radius 30 px = 9.2 m. Rich turquoise blue (64,128,160) with lighter sheen patches (110,170,195), darker under the rim (last 3 px of the radius about 35 % darker), a broken white-turquoise foam ring where the tier-1 sheet lands at radius 17-20 px, darker shadow under the tier-1 bowl inside radius 17 px (about 25 % darker), concentric ripples, a scatter of gold coins (1 px yellow 240,200,70) on the bottom between radius 21 and 27 px.

water_tier.look: Water of the tier bowls from above, planar, inscribed circle radius 14 px. Same turquoise as water, a bright foamy boil in the middle (radius 0-4 px, white-turquoise 200,230,235) where the stem pours out, ripples outward, darker last 2 px under the lip.

stem.look: Baluster stems wrapped once around 8 sides, image top = top of the stem band. White marble (232,226,218) with 8 vertical flutes (5 px pitch: 3 px light, 2 px shadowed groove), gold collar bands in rows 68-70 and 93-95 (with highlight and dark rows), soft grey-pink veins. Periodic in x over its 40 px.

pedestal.look: One face of the leader's octagonal pedestal (each of the 8 faces maps this whole rect). Deep red porphyry (130,30,35) with dark flecks, gold molding rows top (96-98) and bottom (125-127), a gold five-pointed star (pictographic, about 12 px across) centred at (72, 111) with a 1 px dark outline. No text.

gold.look: Gilt surface for the leader figure and the fish, box-mapped. Burnished gold (215,170,55) with broad soft highlight blotches (250,225,120) and dark brown cavity blotches (120,80,25), a fine hammered grain; no directional light. Bleed to the edges.

face.look: Front of the leader's gilded head (wraps over the three front faces of a 6-sided head; x 108 = his right cheek, x 127 = his left). Gold skin; top 3 rows the dark shadow under the cap visor; two dark-bronze eyes (2 x 1 px) at y 101 around x 114 and x 121; a large bushy dark-bronze moustache (80,50,20) 10 px wide x 3 px across y 105-107, centred; a lighter nose ridge above it; strong chin shadow in the bottom 2 rows. Generic, not a real person.

fish.look: Gilded fish skin for the four spouting fish (box-mapped like gold): overlapping scale arcs (4 px) in darker gold on gold, a round dark eye (2 px with a bright pixel) near x 111, y 115 and an open dark mouth band along the left edge (x 108-109). Bleed to the edges.

env_burned_decal.look: Ground scorch mark, one 14 x 14 m quad 0.05 above the ground, planar, rect = whole image. An irregular blast/burn splat about 54 px across, centre slightly off (33, 31): black charred core (16,14,13) with tarry gloss-less patches, dark smoky brown-grey middle (48,42,36), fading through sooty grey streaks radiating outward; the outline jagged and fractal with soot fingers and separate spots outside, holes (unburnt ground showing through) near the edge. Ash flecks: pale grey (150,146,138) and white-grey 1-2 px specks scattered over the middle, a few charred paper scraps. Alpha: hard cut-out, about 45 % of the image opaque, nothing within 2 px of the border.

plaza_features_water.look: Cut-out water shared by both fountains (falling streams, spray crowns, the rich fountain fish spout arcs). Alpha hard 0/255, colour bled under the cut.

sheet.look: Falling water curtain, image top = the lip it pours from, bottom = where it hits the water. Sparse vertical streams so the marble behind shows: pale turquoise (150,206,222) with white cores (240,250,252). Alpha: 3-5 px of scalloped overflow at the top, then 5 streams of 2-3 px per 32 px wavering a little, widening toward the bottom, the bottom 8 rows breaking into foam blobs and drops. Periodic in x.

spray.look: Spray crown card (base at the rect bottom on the tier-2 water): a fan of jets and droplets rising and falling, white (235,245,248) and pale turquoise, solid base band in the bottom 4 rows, 7-9 jets arcing up to y 4, separate drops (1-2 px) around the tips. Nothing within 1 px of the side and top borders.

arc.look: A fish's spout: a parabolic jet leaving the left edge near y 38 (the mouth), rising to about y 34 at x 42 and falling to the bottom edge near x 58, 3 px thick at the mouth tapering to 2 px, white core with turquoise edges, a few drops around the landing at the bottom right, a small splash at the bottom edge.

model_envelope.frame: Blender Z-up, game units (1 m = 1 unit), -Y faces the Street camera. Origin at the footprint centre, ground z = 0.
model_envelope.env_trashcan_burning: Drum radius 1.55, height 4.4 (dented 8-sided), coals at z 3.3, flame cards to z 8.0, smoke card z 6.2-12.6, bags and litter card within radius 3.6. <= 120 tris.
model_envelope.env_fountain_normal: Basin outer radius 5.0 (16-gon), rim top z 1.2, water z 0.8, column radius 0.5 to z 3.0, flared cap to z 3.28, two crossed spray cards (plaza_features_water) to about z 4.6 and a ring of thin streams from the cap rim down to the water. <= 200 tris.
model_envelope.env_fountain_rich: Base step radius 10.6 (z 0-0.4), basin outer radius 10 (16-gon), rim z 2.0, water z 1.5; tier 1 radius 5.5 at z 7-7.6; tier 2 radius 3.0 at z 11-11.5; porphyry pedestal to z 12.8; gilded leader (scaled 1.12) to about z 17.7. Four gilded fish on the rim at the diagonals spouting inward. <= 700 tris.
model_envelope.env_burned_decal: One quad 14 x 14 at z 0.05, 2 tris.
